race.title: Jodie Standing's Point-To-Point Recruits Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: PADDY O'MAHLER enjoyed a fine first season over fences and is given another chance following his comeback run. The remainder hardly look a rock-solid bunch, Some Scope perhaps most interesting with Brian Hughes taking over. PADDY O'MAHLER (IRE) SOME SCOPE MELTON MOSSY (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Melton Mossy (4/7), Paddy O'Mahler (4/1), Move With The Beat (8/1), Finn Lough (10/1), Some Scope (14/1)
